QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Gilberto Daniella
QuestInfo.0: You tried to talk to Gilberto there, but were rebuffed. He said he wouldn't talk to anyone without an appointment. You've got to change his mind!
QuestInfo.1: You finally had an opportunity to introduce yourself to Gilberto, after Tepes vouched for how you helped him out. If you bring up the peace treaty right away, he might take it the wrong way. For now, you introduce yourself as tourist from far away.
QuestInfo.2: Gilberto Daniella doesn't talk to anyone without an appointment but you finally managed to arrange an introduction with Tepes' help. You introduced yourself as a tourist to avoid startling Gilberto, but it all came to nothing when Leon strolled in and revealed your real purpose. Gilberto is clearly suspicious of you.
